_doc: Special weeks are decided when the run starts and are shown on the planning screen. difficulty_shift moves that week's catalogue percentiles; difficulty_mult scales them (Quiet Week: 0.8 = days at 80% of the usual percentile). Boss days still get their boost. "final_week": false keeps a special week out of the run's last week. away_count analysts are unavailable for the whole week. spawn_daily adds a task each day.

name: Swarm Season
desc: Elevated activity forecast. Busier days, but funding +20%.

name: GSNZ Conference Week
desc: Two analysts are presenting at a conference and are away all week.

name: Server Migration
desc: Everything runs 15% slower while the servers move.

name: Media Spotlight
desc: A documentary crew is filming. Trust losses x1.5, funding +40%.

name: Quiet Week
desc: Activity forecast is lower than usual. A chance to rest people.

name: Flu Season
desc: Something is going around. Sick calls x3.

name: Budget Review
desc: Finance is watching. Funding -20%, shop prices -15%.

name: Tsunami Exercise
desc: A national tsunami exercise is running. One exercise inject arrives each day. Trust +5 at the end of the week.
